title: Moments: one fact per entry, computed by the pipeline from tests.json, never typed by hand
description: data/build/moments.json. A library story shows a moment by id and fills {value}, {value_max}, {unit} and {fuel} into its text, so story text never holds a typed number. Outcome groups are the same as web/src/contract.ts OUTCOME_GROUP: burned = burned, completion, flow-terminated; went-out = extinction, self-extinguished. A moment is written only when the fields it needs are recorded; nothing is estimated.

id.description: <investigation>.<kind>, with the outcome appended for outcome-count, e.g. PSI-69.outcome-count-extinction

kind.description: tests-count = rows in tests.json; *-range = min and max of the recorded values (value = min, value_max = max); longest-burn = max burn_time_s; lowest-o2-burned = min o2_pct among rows in the burned group; highest-o2-went-out = max o2_pct among rows in the went-out group; outcome-count = rows with that outcome

label.description: what was computed, in plain English, without the number

fuel.description: fuel of the row that holds the value, when it is one row

n.description: how many rows had the field(s) this moment was computed from

test_ids.description: ids in tests.json of the row(s) that hold the value (min and max rows for a range); empty for counts

url.description: PSI page of the investigation (source.url of its rows)

method.description: how it was computed: field, filter, how many rows had the field
